name: Bar List
description: Ranked bars for a dimension: value and % of total, Top N + Others, several KPIs with switch buttons (incl. calculated ones), drill-down from Category to Sub-Category (up to 4 levels), optional breakdown and target, thin to thick and square to round bars.

name: Funnel
description: Conversion funnel from the measures on the Stages shelf (e.g. Started → Submitted → Approved → Disbursed): one box per stage with % of start and % of previous stage, the drop between stages, overall conversion and the weakest step.

name: KPI Card
description: A row of KPI cards from a plain date and your measures: MTD, last month or last day as the big number, worked out in the extension. Calculated KPIs (e.g. Average Loan Size = Loan Amount / Loans) are rolled up correctly for each period. Comparison, secondary values, target progress, and a chart per card: mini trend, daily bars + running total, bars, line or running total.

name: Multi Measure Trend
description: Several measures over time on one chart. Each measure can be a solid, dashed or dotted line, an area or bars, with its own color and axis, plus a tooltip comparing them.

name: Smart Table
description: Fast flat table for large data (virtual scrolling): sort and filter any column, search, conditional colors, totals, and row selection that drives dashboard actions.

name: Smooth Trend
description: Smooth line trend with a KPI header (latest, MTD, QTD, YTD or your own calculation), growth/degrowth coloring and smart tooltips.
